name: pm-plugin
description: PM productivity plugin for Claude Code. Launches a live Cowork artifact that turns Granola meetings into reviewable JIRA proposals and a Slack summary; builds weekly Slack Canvas update pipelines; walks PMs through an interview to create recurring scheduled agents; routes feedback into a shared Coda hub. Self-bootstraps a user profile (brand voice, JIRA boards, Slack channels) on first run. Four slash commands: /meeting-sync, /pm-feedback, /pm-automations, /canvas-updates-builder.
